ov: كفر قاسم (الإنجليزية: Kafr kasem) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في سوريا وصدر في سنة 1974.
plotEn: Kafr kasem is a 1975 Syrian drama film directed by Borhane Alaouié. It was entered into the 9th Moscow International Film Festival where it won a Diploma. The subject of the film is the Kafr Qasim massacre that occurred in Israel in 1956.
